listing_card.name: Neonates Foundation of India
listing_card.description: NFI is committed to savings lives of newborns, especially those born prematurely or with medical complications that require Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) treatment by partnering with hospitals that has specialised NICU care in different parts of the country.

Geographies Served Programs NICU Support Program District Mysore Bangalore Chandigarh Anantapur Indore Gautam Buddha Nagar Mohali Coimbatore Chennai Gurgaon State Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu Haryana Madhya Pradesh Punjab Uttar Pradesh District Mysore Bangalore Chandigarh Anantapur Indore Gautam Buddha Nagar Mohali Coimbatore Chennai Gurgaon States Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Tamil Nadu Haryana Madhya Pradesh Punjab Uttar Pradesh In our commitment to safeguarding the most vulnerable lives, the Neonates Foundation of India proudly presents the NICU Support Program. This initiative is designed to provide comprehensive and specialized care to newborns from underprivileged families facing critical health challenges, ensuring a strong and healthy start to their lives. Key Components of the NICU Support Program: 1. Immediate Access to Critical Care: Newborns in critical conditions require immediate and specialized care. Our program ensures swift access to Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICUs), equipped with cutting-edge medical technology and staffed by skilled healthcare professionals. 2. Holistic Medical Support: The NICU Support Program covers all aspects of medical care, including diagnostic tests, medications, surgical interventions, and constant monitoring, tailored to meet the unique needs of each newborn. 3. Family-Centered Care: Recognizing the emotional toll on families, our program incorporates family-centered care. We provide emotional and psychological support to parents and caregivers, creating a supportive environment during this challenging time. 4. Nutritional Guidance: Proper nutrition is fundamental to a newborn's development. Our program includes nutritional guidance to ensure that each infant receives the essential nutrients needed for optimal growth and well-being. 5. Maternal Education: Education is a powerful tool for preventive healthcare. The NICU Support Program includes maternal education initiatives, empowering expectant mothers with knowledge on proper prenatal care, reducing the risk of neonatal complications. 6. Post-NICU Transition: The support doesn't end with NICU care. We assist families in the transition post-NICU, providing guidance on postnatal care, nutrition, and overall well-being to ensure a smooth and healthy start for the newborn.
